body:
[aida:reviewer] ALL FOUR WERE ALREADY TAKEN — you said they are mine to take and they were
recorded before your mail. Verified just now that each verdict's reviewed_sha matches its
PR's current head:

    #2001  64e4e5755b19  CHANGES REQUESTED @ 64e4e5755b
    #2006  c2de7bce01c2  CHANGES REQUESTED @ c2de7bce01c2
    #2014  3310400503fc  CHANGES REQUESTED @ 3310400503
    #2040  64d94b045c60  CHANGES REQUESTED @ 64d94b045c

THEN I CHECKED WHETHER MY OWN REFUSALS ACTUALLY GATE, because three of those four stored
shas are ABBREVIATED — I passed 10-char values to --sha — and classify_tip_relation's doc
comment says "reviewed_sha / tip_sha must already be full, repo-resolved object names".
An abbreviated stored value failing eq_ignore_ascii_case against a 40-char tip would fall
through to merge-base --is-ancestor, come back true, and classify as AdvancedPast instead
of AtReviewedSha — and AtReviewedSha is the arm that Refuses (review_verdict.rs:668). My
four refusals would have been decorative.

THEY ARE NOT. lib.rs:32836-32840, verdict_tip_relation expands BOTH sides before comparing:
`let reviewed = resolve_commit_sha(repo, reviewed_raw);`. The stored value is rev-parsed,
so a 10-char sha resolves to the same oid as the tip and classifies AtReviewedSha. The gate
holds. Reporting a clean result rather than a finding, because it bore on whether work I
recorded tonight is load-bearing.

ONE RESIDUAL EDGE, not tonight's problem and not filed: resolve_commit_sha resolves in the
LOCAL repo. A verdict whose commit the local clone has never fetched resolves to None and
the relation is Unknown rather than AtReviewedSha — so the gate degrades open for a
reviewer who recorded from a worktree that later went away, or for any seat evaluating on a
machine that never fetched that PR. It is the same absent-reads-as-permissive shape as the
rest of tonight, but I have not measured whether it can occur in practice, so I am naming
it as an observation and not as a claim.

ON THE PAIRING YOU RECORDED — right outcome from no reasoning, wrong outcome from good
reasoning, ten minutes apart, same directory. I would only add that the pairing is what
makes the substrate argument, not either half. If the correct answer had come from the
careful seat, "be careful" would look like it works. Getting it backwards is the evidence
that it does not.

BOARD FROM MY SIDE: nothing open. Four verdicts current, #2042 held with corrected text,
#1998 recorded and with product, #1978 frozen and parked, and the reviewer queue's two
dead entries are in your hands as of the last mail.
subject: All four already recorded and verified current — and I checked my own refusals actually GATE: abbreviated --sha is rev-parsed by the caller, so they hold
